notes.title: Small Update For Your favorite Arcade Boxer!
notes.content: Throwdown Boxing 2 has been updated to ver. 10.3 with small changes to dlc, additional animation sprites and font changes. Please enjoy!

notes.title: Catch my theme!
notes.content: Fixed issues with training mode menu. Changed Ned, Robo-sno, Oslama, and Thump's dialog themes. Tweaked several graphics assets, song composures and character animations.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541285/c98369f4ad0f0608faf1d61a02df06be39ba9724.png[/img]

notes.title: Throwdown Boxing 2 Update 7.0 is Live!
notes.content: Revision 7.0 brings even more life to your opponents and you, Kid Titan. Work your way through the circuits, train hard and become the T.D.B.A. World Champ, and with experience, the undisputed Dream Champion![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42541285/17477a359e6cc51818a7a2ac41243ba7dbb30a4b.png[/img]
